## Overview

A group project with 3 other students, all done in Excel. 
We were given data about an airline company and some assumptions about their demand and profit. 
Using this, we had to generate a Monte Carlo simulation to simulate the impact on 
profits of different overbooking strategies and then determine the optimal strategy for the airline.
